entries.brief: ONE square original painterly fantasy bestiary portrait for SKAZ, restrained encyclopedia, broad sculpted brush shapes clearly readable at 40 px, moderate detail, warm upper-left light and cool shadows. COMMONER: a mature human village woman with sun-weathered tan skin, brown eyes, dark hair loosely tied beneath a simple linen headscarf, plain worn earth-brown wool tunic and cream linen collar. Honest attentive expression, no glamour. A plain short wooden club tucked beside her shoulder, no armor or magical equipment. Head and shoulders, entire head fully inside generous transparent margins, compact rounded silhouette for a token. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. No scenery, no text, no letters, no border or frame.
